_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. config.json is gitignored so your settings and copy stay private. Connection requests send only when safety.sending_enabled is true. DMs stay blocked while their copy is a placeholder (require_dm_copy_before_send).

account.name: Your Name
account._account_note: Display name to confirm you are logged in as the right person. The rest is informational only.

_source_csv_note: Path to your leads CSV, relative to the repo root. Put your real list at data/leads.csv (it is gitignored). See data/leads.example.csv for the format.

csv_columns._comment: Map your CSV's header names to the canonical fields. Only linkedin_url is required; the rest improve personalization. Keys are canonical fields; values are the column names in YOUR csv.

safety._comment: Gate every send. Start with sending_enabled false for a dry run, review the batch, then flip it on for a small supervised test.

copy._comment: DMs will NOT send while their body still contains [PLACEHOLDER. Replace with your own copy. {first_name} is substituted per lead.

open_profile_dm.subject: [PLACEHOLDER - your open-profile DM subject]
open_profile_dm.body: [PLACEHOLDER - your open-profile DM body. Do NOT send until replaced and approved.]
